title: Daily Supertrend ATR10 multiplier-3 long/cash timing
thesis: A ratcheted volatility-scaled band may remain in BTC trends through ordinary noise yet switch to cash after volatility-adjusted breakdowns, preserving enough upside while avoiding sufficiently deep adverse paths to improve fee-adjusted risk-adjusted performance over full-capital buy-and-hold.
mechanism: For each complete UTC day, compute gap-aware true range and Wilder RMA ATR10, construct midpoint plus-or-minus multiplier-times-ATR bands, ratchet both bands using prior close and prior final bands, and update the Supertrend direction from prior state. Hold full BTC in uptrend and zero-yield cash in downtrend, executing state changes at the next H1 open.
economic_rationale: The mechanism changes its trend threshold with current causal volatility and path-dependent band state instead of relying on a fixed price channel or endpoint return. It is useful only if multiplier 3 retains material after-cost upside, reduces drawdown, improves Calmar and is supported by annual breadth and rejection-only multiplier neighbors.
